hero.title: Turn requests into revenue

howItWorks.label: How it works
howItWorks.title: The smarter way to freight.
howItWorks.subtitle: Three simple steps. Zero missed opportunities.

step1.title: Centralize requests
step1.description: Clients submit requests through your branded portal. View, sort, and respond to everything in one place with built-in chat and voice calling.

step2.title: Route & assign
step2.description: Assign requests to the right team member and collaborate with internal notes on every deal.

step3.title: Respond faster
step3.description: Track and respond to every request from a single dashboard. No more switching between email, phone, and spreadsheets.

builtForBusiness.label: Built for your business
builtForBusiness.title: Configure everything to match how you work
builtForBusiness.description: Your logo, your colors, your subdomain. Clients see your brand, not ours.

portal.title: Branded Client Portal
portal.description: Your clients submit requests at company.ortelius.app. Professional, branded, always on.

setup.title: Business Setup
setup.description: Configure once, work your way forever. The platform bends to your operations, not the other way around.

respondInstantly.label: Respond instantly
respondInstantly.title: Built-in chat and voice calling
respondInstantly.description: Stop juggling email, phone, and spreadsheets. Communicate with clients directly in the platform.

chat.title: Real-time Chat
chat.description: A dedicated chat with each client. Requests, quotes, and invoices live in the conversation.

calling.title: One-Click Calling
calling.description: Click to call clients directly from the platform. All calls logged and tracked automatically.

trackEverything.label: Track everything
trackEverything.title: Quote to invoice. Nothing missed
trackEverything.description: Know exactly where every deal stands. From first request to final delivery, track it all in one place.

pipeline.title: Visual Pipeline
pipeline.description: See exactly where each deal stands at a glance, from request to delivery.

filters.title: Smart Filters
filters.description: Sort by status, client, date, route, or urgency. Find any request in seconds.

subtitle.choosePlan: Choose the plan that fits your team.
subtitle.withTrial: All plans include a 14-day free trial. Pick the one that fits your team. Try for free, no credit card required.

freeTrial.question: Is there a free trial?
freeTrial.answer: Yes! All plans include a 14-day free trial. No credit card required.

changePlan.question: Can I change my plan later?
changePlan.answer: Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately and we'll prorate any billing differences.

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer: We use Stripe for secure payments and accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and SEPA direct debit.

trialEnds.question: What happens when my trial ends?
trialEnds.answer: You'll be notified before your trial ends. If you don't add a payment method, your account will be downgraded to read-only mode until you subscribe.

annualDiscount.question: Do you offer discounts for annual billing?
annualDiscount.answer: Yes, we offer a 20% discount when you choose annual billing. Contact our sales team for more details on enterprise pricing.

contact.title: Talk to our sales team
contact.subtitle: We'd love to learn about your team's challenges and show you how Ortelius Quest can help.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Ortelius Quest.

freeTrial.question: Is there a free trial?
freeTrial.answer: Yes! You get 14 days to try Ortelius Quest free.

getStarted.question: How long does it take to get started?
getStarted.answer: Your organization can be fully configured and ready to welcome clients in 5-10 minutes.

customDomain.question: Can I use my own domain?
customDomain.answer: Your branded portal is hosted at company.ortelius.app with your custom logo and branding.

closeDeals.question: How does Ortelius Quest help me close more deals?
closeDeals.answer: By centralizing all freight requests in one place, you never miss an opportunity. Respond 3x faster with built-in communication tools, and keep your entire team aligned with real-time collaboration features.

teamUse.question: Can my whole team use Ortelius Quest?
teamUse.answer: Yes! Add unlimited team members, assign requests to specific people, and collaborate with internal notes on every deal.

security.question: Is my data secure?
security.answer: All chat messages are encrypted to keep your communications secure and private.

onboarding.question: Do you provide onboarding support?
onboarding.answer: Yes! We provide onboarding videos during platform setup to help you configure everything properly.
